subject: Request: Combined trial extension + credit & discount for Clearmont pilot — exec clearance
messages:
From: Marta Lopez <marta@clearmont.io>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@clearmont.io>, Legal - Clearmont <legal@clearmont.io>
Date: Mon, 25 May 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood pilot — ask on credits & timeline

Hi Sergio,

Appreciate the demo last week. We ran this by the procurement team and there are two blockers on our side: (1) our purchasing cycle won't clear until late June and (2) Finance wants coverage for a short pilot in case we can't get an immediate PO.

To keep momentum, would Redwood consider a 60-day trial extension + a $40k consumption credit applied during the pilot window? That, plus a modest commercial discount if we convert to a 12-month commit within 90 days, would get us over the finish line.

I'm attaching a rough procurement timeline so you can see our internal cadence. Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Marta
VP of Engineering
Clearmont Health
[Attachment: procurement_timeline.xlsx (Excel)]

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Redwood pilot — ask on credits & timeline

Team — forwarding Marta's request. Quick summary: Clearmont (mid-market healthcare) is asking for a combined concession to bridge procurement: 60-day trial extension, $40k consumption credit during pilot, and a conversion discount if they sign a 12-month commitment within 90 days. They are motivated and technically ready; procurement timeline attached.

Ask: can we greenlight this as an exception? I think the deal economics are favorable if we get the conversion commitment. I’d like an executive clearance (Aditya / Priyom) and confirmation from Finance on accounting for credits (Neha). Laura, would CS be able to support an extended pilot operationally?

Proposed guardrails:
- Credits applied only during the pilot period and expire at the end of the 60-day extension.
- Discount contingent on signed 12-month contract execution within 90 days.
- SOW to be signed and countersigned by both parties; no data residency changes.

Attachments: Clearmont_SOW_draft.pdf, procurement_timeline.xlsx

Thanks — happy to discuss at 11:30 if we need to triage.

—Sergio

On Tue, 26 May 2026 at 10:12 AM Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — forwarding Marta's request. Quick summary...

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 26 May 2026 11:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood pilot — ask on credits & timeline

Sergio — thanks for the context. I'm inclined to approve this exception with the following conditions:

1) Cap the total credits at $40k as requested.
2) Require a minimal conversion commitment: 12-month term at a $60k ARR minimum if converted within 90 days.
3) Add a rollback clause if usage patterns indicate abuse (we can define a cadence).

From a commercial perspective, this supports pipeline velocity and is a reasonable investment to secure a strategic healthcare customer. Priyom/Neha — please confirm operational feasibility and accounting treatment. If both sign off, I give executive clearance to proceed.

-Aditya (CRO)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 27 May 2026 09:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood pilot — ask on credits & timeline

Aditya/Sergio — Finance is ok with the $40k credit as a promotional contra-revenue item, provided we document the conversion trigger and ensure credits hit usage (not invoice line) so accounting treats them as a usage offset. Two asks from my side:

1) Legal needs the conversion language in the SOW (I flagged a draft clause to protect Redwood if they fail to convert).
2) We need a short note in the deal record with the approval path (Aditya approved; Priyom to confirm CS support).

If Priyom confirms CS support, finance will route the credit and mark the account for follow-up reporting.

-Neha

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 28 May 2026 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood pilot — ask on credits & timeline

Sergio/Team — CS can support a 60-day extension operationally. Two implementation notes:

- We will provision the pilot environment scoping and an onboarding checklist; CS will own weekly health checks (2x during the extension).
- If conversion occurs, CS will transition to a success plan and track the OKRs agreed in the SOW.

I confirm support. Priyom (VP, Customer Success)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Marta Lopez <marta@clearmont.io>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Legal - Clearmont <legal@clearmont.io>
Date: Fri, 31 May 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Approval: Clearmont pilot concession (60-day extension + $40k credit + conversion discount)

Marta — good to connect. Executive clearance granted to proceed with the concession as follows: 

- 60-day trial extension from the original end date.
- One-time $40,000 consumption credit applied during the extended pilot period only.
- Conditional commercial discount: 18% off list for a 12-month commit executed within 90 days of pilot end.

Next steps:
1) Sergio: please update the SOW to include the conversion clause and the rollback/abuse language Neha requested.
2) Neha/Finance: please prepare the contra-revenue paperwork and apply credit to usage.
3) Priyom/CS: stand up the extended pilot onboarding and weekly health checks.
4) Marta: provide a PO or email confirmation of intent when available; we will keep the pilot open until your procurement clears per the timeline you shared.

Sergio — can you send the updated SOW & DocuSign link by Monday? Marta, we’ll attach the DocuSign record here once the SOW is ready.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to getting Clearmont online.

-Aditya
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference
[DocuSign: https://docusign.net/CLRM/Doc1234]
